'''Michael Sorrell'''<ref name="dt-18351">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/18351 Hero of the Day], DeckTech (Michael "choker" Sorrell, 15 August 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/18351/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/18351/ GitHub Pages].</ref> (DeckTech handle '''choker''') posted a [[Dark]] [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|Hunt Down]] list on DeckTech in August 2001.
